messages:
maria_sales: quick heads up — Prospect (FinServ POC) asked for audit log retention \u003e=7y + KMS with HSM-backed keys. They want a 6-month POC commit and an option to convert to annual reserved after. asking if we can do staged pricing / discounts.

alex_se: clarifying q: is this token-level request logging or just system audit exports? pricing differs. also, do they need redaction/prompt masking?

maria_sales: they said full request logs initially, but will accept redaction. target ingest ~200GB/day, ~6k user requests/day. HIPAA + SOC2 required. they asked whether embeddings/payloads can be excluded from logs.

dealdesk_josh: @maria_sales flagged. baseline audit-log pricing (public rate card):
```text
90d retention: $0.15/GB/mo
1yr retention: $0.10/GB/mo
7yr archival tier: $0.06/GB/mo (cold storage)
KMS HSM add-on: $1,200/mo per tenancy (min 6mo)
Audit exports / monthly egress support: $500/mo
```
For POCs we can offer a commit discount. Rules: up to 30% standard discount for 6mo commits; up to 35% requires pricing lead approval and $75k+ commit. special terms need deal desk + legal signoff.

alex_se: operational note — HSM is a flat infra fee; customer-managed KMS (non-HSM) is usually free for the POC but we log the key usage. Also note there will be egress charges for large monthly exports.

legal_elaine: HIPAA onboarding requires a signed BAA, controls for key separation, and retention/deletion attestations. for HSM we need vendor attestation and key custody docs. SOC2 plus a BAA is the minimum.

sre_ops: perf/ops note — 200GB/day ingest will push our archiver and cold-store pipelines; expect ~+20% infra uplift estimate. recommend canary at 50GB/day to validate cost profile during POC.

maria_sales: can dealdesk draft a staged quote: Phase A (6mo POC) = 90d audit logs + non-HSM KMS, 30% off; Phase B (post-commit) = 7yr archival + HSM add-on at negotiated rate? customer prefers to defer HSM until GA.

dealdesk_josh: we can do a staged quote. propose: Phase A: 6mo commit, 30% off audit-log rates, no HSM (customer-managed keys). Phase B: convert to annual reserved with 7yr tier + HSM add-on; price TBD (we can pre-allocate provisional HSM price line $1,200/mo). need pricing lead signoff and legal BAA before Phase B switches. I'll prepare LOE and conditional pricing.

josh_price: provisionally approve 30% cap for 6mo POC contingent on BAA and >=$50k commit. 35% requires exec approval.

maria_sales: thanks — one more product question from them: can we redact prompt text from logs or only prefix tokens? they wanted assurance sensitive fields can be stripped.

alex_se: yes — we support selective redaction and prefix-only logging. small config snippet below (will require ops to enable in the POC config):
```json
{"audit": {"mode": "prefix_only", "redact_patterns": ["prompt_text", "user_message"], "exclude": ["embeddings_payload"]}}
```

maria_sales: perfect. i'll gather exact ingest numbers and push back on HSM timing. next steps: @dealdesk_josh pls prepare 6mo staged quote with export fees and HSM as optional add-on line item. thanks! :pray:

dealdesk_josh: on it — aiming EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

compliance_bot: automated reminder: create compliance ticket for HIPAA onboarding -> CP-482.

maria_sales: created ticket CP-482-POC and linked in the CRM. i'll upload metrics once I have them. cheers.
